title: Sam Altman says currently "the idea of putting data centers in space is ridiculous" and that it is "not something that's going to matter at scale this decade" (Bijin Jose/The Indian Express)
summary: Bijin Jose / The Indian Express: Sam Altman says currently “the idea of putting data centers in space is ridiculous” and that it is “not something that's going to matter at scale this decade” — Once allies at OpenAI, Sam Altman and Elon Musk are now sharply divided over the future of AI infrastructure.
contentText:
Bijin Jose / The Indian Express :

Sam Altman says currently “the idea of putting data centers in space is ridiculous” and that it is “not something that's going to matter at scale this decade”   —  Once allies at OpenAI, Sam Altman and Elon Musk are now sharply divided over the future of AI infrastructure.
